source.license: MIT (dataset); issue text and code from the upstream repositories

semantics.ranking: each arm returns ranked line ranges; the same localization metrics score every arm
semantics.recallAt5OverPlanned: incomplete or failed queries count as zero
semantics.returned: context size delivered to the caller: lines in the top 5 ranges and characters of all returned ranges
semantics.labels: patch sites and quoted-docstring functions; not exhaustive relevance
semantics.replay: captured Jev scores per fragment; candidate arms mask every other fragment, so Jev work is the candidate set only
semantics.candidateRecall: share of required evidence units fully inside the evaluated candidate fragments (an upper bound on what Jev can return)
semantics.jevInputTokens: reference-token estimate for evaluating the candidate set alone, batched like the engine
